column1: Figure 2: Effects of position treatments on litter decomposition in the semi-arid ecosystem. Symbols indicate litter mass remaining (%) over time under different position treatments. The inset shows the litter decomposition rate, k (year^?1) with black bar representing surface litter and grey bar representing standing litter. Values are means +/- SE (*n* = 3). Different letters and the asterisks indicate significant difference between surface and standing litter based on independent samples t-test. *P < 0·05; **P < 0·01. P, position; *T*, time.
